{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print only the mean values with 2 decimal places to ensure precision
print(mean_flipper_by_species.round(2))

# Extract and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')
print(f'Mean flipper length: {highest_mean_value:.2f} mm')"}
